content.title: Florida takes 2026 SEC Championship title in a nail-biter | International Gymnast Magazine Online
content.text: 2026 SEC Championships – Final Standings:Florida 198.175Oklahoma 198.150LSU 197.950Alabama 197.475Georgia 197.450Missouri 197.075Arkansas 196.975Kentucky 196.925Auburn 195.300How the 2026 SEC Gymnastics Championships was won: Session II (Oklahoma #1, LSU #2, Florida #3, Alabama #4)ROTATION 1:Vault – Oklahoma:Blessey – well done front handspring front pike half tiny hop back – 9.9Wells – big Yur 1.5 mid size step forward – 9.85Scheible – fine front handspring front pike half, hop back – 9.8Estep – little low on the table on Yur 1.5 fine on height, step forward on the landing – 9.85Mueller – fine Yur 1 1/2 but steps back – 9.825 Fatta – good Yur 1 1/2, near stuck, but moved her foot just enough to deny the stick – 9.9Event total – 49.325Bars – LSU:Zeiss – hits, and sticks the full twisting double tuck – 9.9Cowan – Ray to bail clean, double layout hop back – 9.85Ulrich – perfect on Maloney to Pak, piro maybe a tad late, stuck double layout – 9.9Chio – Maloney to bail fine, Khorkina clean, stuck full twisting double tuck – 9.95Blackson – bail is fine, Khorkina good height, double layout two tiny hops back – 9.875McClain – Church very, very close, managed to get the kip cast to handstand, step back on full twisting double tuck – they will drop this routine – 9.75Event total – 49.475Beam – Florida:Draser – solid on series, sticks the leap series too, dismount is stuck – 9.875Arana – small wobble on switch half, which was also short on split, dismount is gainer to the side and stuck – 9.8Blakely – triple wolf turn fine, front aerial to ff solid, dismount is stuck – 9.9Frazier – front aerial to layout step out series is done well, split to split ring fine, cartwheel 1 1/2 stuck with some effort – 9.85DiCello – well done routine, stuck gainer full at the end – 9.95Harris-Miranda – nails everything, another stuck landing for Florida on round off 1 1/2 – 9.95Event total – 49.525Floor – Alabama:LaCoursiere – double tuck mount, clean layout to Rudi to stag jump – 9.825Rybicki – double tuck mount is fine, 1 1/2 to front full cleanly done – 9.85Matters – tuck step out to double tuck fine landing, fine double pike – 9.85Ra-Akbar – tuck step out to 2 1/2 controlled step forward, 1 1/2 to layout clean – 9.925Sears – double layout just a bit short on the landing, saved with a quick finishing lunge – 9.85Gladieux – good full in mount, front layout to Rudi to jump well done – 9.95Event total – 49.425ROTATION 2:Vault – Alabama:Matters – fine Yur 1.5 large hop forward – 9.825LaCoursiere – 9.85Sears – 9.8Gladieux – big hop forwred on her Yur 1.5 – 9.8Paradise – good Yur 1.5 two tiny steps back – 9.75Ra-Akbar – huge Yur 1 1/2 but also takes a huge hop forward – Kvamme – gets 9.85 for her Yur 1.5 Event total – 49.175Bars – Oklahoma:Pederson – Ray good, Pak good, piro good, double layout holds the stick with a deep landing and extra legs apart – 9.9Murphy – Maloney to Pak pretty long line, piro a tad late but connected to sole circle, sticks the giant full double tuck – pretty gymnastics – 9.95 well deserved! Fatta – great routine, tiny hop back on the double layout – 9.9Estep – Tkatchev a bit low, the rest is clean and another stuck landing – 9.9Scheible – Jaeger is fine, cast a bit short, bail good, last cast is better, sticks the full twisting double tuck – 9.9Torrez – solid, releases and casts are well done, tiny adjustment hop at the end – 9.95Event total – 49.6Beam – LSU:Coen – ff layout stuck, hit the rest – 9.85Zeiss – side aerial small balance check, bigger wobble after the series with a turn and an arm circle, sticks the tuck gainer full at the end – 9.8Drayton – small hop back on the round off double twist dismount – 9.85Lincoln – front aerial to ff fine, great leaps, ff 1 1/2 is stuck – 9.9McClain – very good aerial to ff and side aerial, leaps are well done, sticks the gainer full – 9.95Chio – strong as usual, sticks it, not a 10 but 9.95Floor – Florida:Disidore – Rudi to stag jump mount, 1 1/2 to layout near the line and stumbled to not get out but it looks like she did – 9.825Ferris – full in well done, 1 1/2 layout clean – 9.875Frazier – fine double layout mount, good flexibility on the leaps, fine landing on the double tuck at the end – 9.9DiCello – full in mount is good, step back maybe tiny slide, 1 1/2 to layout clean – 9.9Blakely – big double front little over and the stag after is long and near out of bounce, takes another step but stays in, 1 1/2 to layout floats and good – 9.85Harris-Miranda – front tuck step out to double tuck kind of a big step back but holds it, 1 1/2 to layout half to stag jump no issues – 9.9Event total – 49.425Session II standings after two events:LSU 98.975Florida 98.95Oklahoma 98.925Alabama 98.6ROTATION 3:Vault – Florida:Pilgrim – clean and precise Yur 1.5 small hop forward – 9.9Frazer – DTY, mid size hop back – 9.85DiCello – good Yurchenko 1 1/2 small hop forward – 9.9Ferris – another good Yurchenko 1 1/2 with a small controlled hop forward – 9.875Blakely – well done Yurchenko half on layout half off with a small hop back – 9.9Harris-Miranda – Yurchenko 1 1/2 with a small hop back then step back to solute – Florida will drop this – 9.8Event total – 49.425Bars – Alabama:Walker – clean routine, stuck full twisting double tuck at the end – 9.875Gladieux – 9.85Pawlak – little lose on the Maloney to bail, chest down on the double layout which results in a hop forward – 9.825Fuller – hits and sticks the double layout, with a lean forward – 9.9LaCoursiere – Maloney to Pak pretty, Maloney half yes, full twisting double tuck stuck but chest down very low and arm circles – 9.875Ra-Akbar – perfection, till the dismount, takes hop back on the double tuck – 9.9Event total: 49.4Beam – Oklahoma:Fatta – very strong routine, sticks the gainer full but holds her chest down a bit too low – 9.875Wells – small balance check on side aerial, nails the series, sticks the 1 1/2 which has good height – 9.925Murphy – great work with elegant look on every skill, sticks the dismount – 9.925Pederson – series solid, switch side stuck, double twist dismount step back – 9.85Mueller – hits and sticks, wide legs on the stick – 9.9Torrez – nails the side aerial to layout, precise on the rest, sticks the dismount -10.0 – first one in the competition! Event total – 49.625Floor – LSU: Innes – clean front double full, then clean 1 1/2 layout Rudi to jump at the end is without any issues – 9.9Ballou – double layout good landing to dance pose, layout to Rudi is fine at the end – 9.875Coen – front double full controls the step out of it, layout to front full is fine, lots of height on the straddle fulls – 9.9Drayton – double layout small step forward, and also takes a step back on her double tuck at the end – 9.825Chio – full twisting double layout step back but a bit out of control, holds it though, 2 1/2 to front tuck clean – 9.9Lincoln – huge double layout mount – 9.95Event total – 49.525Session II standings after thee events:Oklahoma – 148.550LSU – 148.500Florida – 148.375Alabama – 148.000ROTATION 4:Vault – LSU:Zeiss – well done Yur 1 1/2, tinniest hop on the landing – 9.875McClain – massive Yurchenko full, good execution, small hop back – 9.85Roberts – big front pike half, rebound and hop back – 9.9Lincoln – big, big Yurchenko 1 1/2 tiny hop forward, and then one more tiny hop – 9.85Drayton – big Yur 1.5 tiny hop and a tiny step – 9.8Chio – 9.975 for another stuck Yur 1.5 – highest score on the event at this competition! Event total – 49.45Bars – Florida:Frazier – Maloney to Pak perfect, good piro, sticks the double layout – 9.9Pilgrim – Maloney to Tkatchev well done, Pak fine, piro fine, stuck full twisting double tuck – 9.925Blakely – stalder piked Tkatchev to Pak huge amplitude, double front half stuck – 9.975DiCello – Church to Pak great, sticks the full twisting double tuck dismount – 9.975Harris-Miranda – she held three of the cast to handstands and the rest was perfection, stuck double layout – 10.0! McCusker – hit clean, small hop on the double tuck though – 9.925Event total – 49.8 Beam – Alabama:LaCoursiere – 9.85Birt – 9.825Gladieux – 9.875Ladanyi – 9.9Fuller – 9.9Kvamme – 9.95Event total – 49.475Floor – Oklahoma:Murphy – clean two pass routine – 9.9Fatta – front full step out to 2 1/2 big step forward but holds it, front double full to step and kick – 9.925Wells – front tuck step out to double tuck good landing, 1 1/2 to front layout at the end – 9.9Pawlak – double pike clean, 1 1/2 to front full also clean – 9.875Mueller – front tuck to double tuck small step forward, layout to Rudi messy and low landing – 9.85Estep – good start on layout to front double full, good 2 1/2 to dance at the end – 9.95 not enough for the win!Event total – 49.6
